definitions.explanation: A gathering of people who meet regularly to study or learn about a particular topic together, common in both academic and professional settings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一回|いっかい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧{勉強会|べんきょうかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a study group once a week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{勉強会|べんきょうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いている→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: We hold study meetings within the company.

examples.japanese: ⟦プログラミング→プログラミング：06099_puroguramingu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{勉強会|べんきょうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}したら→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧、⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: When I attended a programming study group, I made friends with the same goals.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧ (study) and ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (meeting, gathering). Covers a wide range from casual peer study sessions to formal professional development workshops.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勉強会|べんきょうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a study meeting
- {勉強会|べんきょうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to attend a study meeting
- {勉強会|べんきょうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{主催|しゅさい}する→主催する：17278_shusaisuru⟧: to organize a study meeting
- ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧{勉強会|べんきょうかい}: in-company study session
- ⟦{自主|じしゅ}→自主：13979_jishu⟧{勉強会|べんきょうかい}: self-organized study group

USAGE:
In the workplace, {勉強会|べんきょうかい} often refers to informal knowledge-sharing sessions where employees present topics or skills to colleagues. In the tech industry, community-run {勉強会|べんきょうかい} (meetups) are very popular. The word has a more voluntary, collaborative nuance compared to ⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧ (formal training) or ⟦{講座|こうざ}→講座：09790_kouza⟧ (course/lecture).
